content: Reconnect/resume pitfalls from Baileys/whatsmeow issues and Baileys lifecycle docs: (1) Disconnect reason taxonomy matters — 401 loggedOut = never reconnect (delete state, request re-pair); 428/408 = safe reconnect with backoff; 515 restartRequired = reconnect immediately (server asks after pairing); 440 connectionReplaced = another device took the slot; 411 multideviceMismatch = library too old. Treating all closes alike either burns re-pairings or loops on a dead session. (2) Fixed-interval reconnect loops hammering WhatsApp worsen detection and hide failures — Baileys fix: track consecutive closes, surface error after 2nd, exponential backoff 3s→60s cap. (3) Silent retry never surfacing status leaves UI stuck at 'Connecting...'. (4) In-flight IQ (usync device-list queries) fail with 'websocket disconnected before info query returned response' — commands must be tied to connection generation and retried after reconnect, not against a dead socket. (5) stream:error 515 right after pair-success: persisted credentials may not yet include all pair lifecycle acks — handle the restart-required boundary before treating session as durable. (6) India-specific: WhatsApp reportedly force-logs-out Web sessions every 6 hours (regional policy) — reconnect must assume periodic server-initiated disconnects. (7) Silent session death: device_removed 401 can arrive after hours; must be an explicit terminal event, not a retry loop.
